messages:
Mike Chen: Heads-up — coverage gap for next weekend (Sat/Sun). Amanda is OOO, Kevin is partial PTO on Sat. Need a last-minute fill for primary or secondary.

oncall-bot: Rotation snapshot — primary: Amanda Yu, secondary: Kevin Ortiz, next shift start: 2024-06-22 00:00 UTC. Pager schedule pinned.

Sara Patel: I can take primary for Saturday if that helps. I'm on PST but awake for the overnight pages. Will need a short handoff note. :wave:

Kevin Ortiz: I can cover 08:00-20:00 UTC on Sat (afternoon local), but won't be available overnight. If Sara picks up primary, I can be secondary during that window.

Lina Morales: Runbook pointers — please read the "Weekend on-call checklist" and "EU dedicated mitigation" prior to switching. Link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/oncall/weekend-handoff (permissions: eng-oncall).

Lina Morales: Quick paste of the critical steps (also in the runbook):
```
1) Acknowledge PagerDuty page immediately.
2) If service degradation, run `redwoodctl incidents list --region eu --status open` to see active alerts.
3) To add temporary capacity: `redwood infra scale --pool eu-dedicated --delta +2` (notify infra on Slack #eng-infra).
4) If latency persists, flip fallback-model via Console -> Model Routing -> Enable fallback "gpt-compat-lite" for eu region.
5) Escalate to SRE lead if no mitigation within 20m.
```

Mike Chen: Customer impact notes — likely increased latency for Dedicated EU tenants if pool saturates. Potentially affected accounts: AcmeCorp-EU (eu-123), FinApp (eu-pay). Please run the customer-impact query when alerted: `redwoodctl customers impacted --region eu --since 1h`.

Sara Patel: Confirmed I can accept pages. Tested phone and PD overrides earlier today. :thumbsup:

Kevin Ortiz: Ok — I'll be secondary 08:00-20:00 UTC Sat. After 20:00 UTC I'm unavailable. Mike, can you cover the 20:00-00:00 UTC overlap if needed?

Mike Chen: Yep I can cover late overlap 20:00-00:00 UTC and do the pager test at 16:00 UTC Sat to validate routing. I'll also push a short handoff note to PagerDuty overrides.

Amanda Yu: Thanks all — I'm offline for family travel. Appreciate the coverage. Leaving a short note in my calendar and the runbook where I left step-by-step for any account-specific tickets I was tracking.

opsbot: Reminder — please add PD overrides for temporary primary change: `opsbot add-override --user Sara.Patel --from 2024-06-22T00:00Z --to 2024-06-22T23:59Z`

Mike Chen: Action items: 1) Sara accepts primary for Sat (done) 2) Kevin secondary 08:00-20:00 UTC 3) Mike overlap 20:00-00:00 UTC 4) Lina will paste runbook link into PD override note.

Lina Morales: Added runbook excerpt and customer-impact checklist to the PD override note. Also left quick commands for infra to scale and the console path to flip fallback model.

deploy-bot: Canary reminder — there is a small runtime rollout scheduled Fri 18:00 UTC. If it goes sideways, please escalate to the on-call primary immediately.

Mike Chen: Important — if the Friday deploy triggers any errors and reduces capacity, we may need to pre-scale EU pools before the weekend. I'll coordinate with infra to pre-scale +1 if canary shows increased error rates.

Sara Patel: Good call. I can be on standby Fri 18:00-22:00 UTC for the canary monitoring and do a quick handoff note after.

Kevin Ortiz: One more thing: timezone callouts in the handoff note please — local times confuse folks. Use UTC ranges.

Mike Chen: Agreed — handoff will be UTC ranges only. I'll update the shared calendar and PD overrides now. Will also add a short "if busy" mitigation: enable fallback model + notify customers via status.redwood if we flip fallback.

Sara Patel: I'll run through the checklist tonight so I'm prepped. If anyone sees a page that's obviously repeated errors (same stacktrace), call it out in thread and tag me @Sara.

Lina Morales: Added a one-click checklist link to the PD override and left step-by-step for on-call tasks: pager acceptance test, infra scale commands, customer-impact query, and chat template for status page messages.

Mike Chen: Thanks team. Final confirmation: Sara primary Sat 00:00-23:59 UTC, Kevin secondary 08:00-20:00 UTC Sat, Mike overlap coverage 20:00-00:00 UTC. Amanda OOO. I'll update rota and close this thread once overrides show active.

Sara Patel: :thumbsup: all set from my side.

Kevin Ortiz: Thanks — will be reachable during my window.

oncall-bot: PagerDuty override active for Sara Patel 2024-06-22 00:00 UTC -> 2024-06-22 23:59 UTC (added by Mike Chen).

Mike Chen: Closing notes: if you pick a last-minute fill in future, please confirm PD phone test once override is applied. Saves a lot of hair-pulling. :grin:

Sara Patel: Will do. Thanks everyone!
